name: Layout Composer
description: Cartographic print layout designer: map frames with locked scale, custom shapes and per-frame layers, DMS/DD/UTM grids, legends for vector, raster and tile layers, attribute tables and charts, matplotlib-style color bars, LaTeX, Google Fonts and Material Symbols, QGIS .qpt import/export, and PNG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
